title: Composition of local finite-free refinements
statement:
theorem exists_condensedQbar_refinement_of_local
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (P : CategoryTheory.Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) X))
    (𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X)
    (hC : ∀ (i : 𝒰.I₀), ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage (𝒰.X i),
      ∀ (j : C.I₀), ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty
        ((CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ)
          (C.f j ≫ 𝒰.f i)).obj P ≅
          Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) (C.X j)) r)) :
    ∃ 𝒲 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ i : 𝒲.I₀,
      ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty
        ((CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) (𝒲.f i)).obj P ≅
          Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) (𝒲.X i)) r)

source.place: covering composition axiom for a pretopology

proof.text: Choose a local refinement cover over every member of the original cover and form the sigma-indexed family of composite morphisms. The indexed composition axiom makes this family a pro-etale cover, and each composite member carries the local finite-free isomorphism.
